summary: FASE 7 — Portal Cliente (Gate + Dashboard + Profile + /apply wizard) tested end-to-end. Backend: 14/14 pytest pass covering /client/me, /client/dashboard (12-month yield series, field mapping principal/accrued/start_date/maturity_date, KPIs, projection), /apply/context (valid & invalid token), /apply/finalize (consume single-use → 401 on reuse, accept_terms required, alert + outbound email created, org.kyb_status flipped to in_review). Auth required (401 without cookie) confirmed on /client/* endpoints. Tenant isolation verified by comparing alemany vs finpact dashboards. Frontend: client.admin@alemany.capital (approved) → no banner, action buttons as <A> links with no data-disabled, KPIs populated ($540k principal / 8 active positions in seed, table slices to 6 rendered + 'Ver todas' link, ~$430k tokens, APR 8.50%), yield-card + projection-card render, recent transactions list shows confirmed items. client.admin@finpact.io → ClientGateBanner present with data-status='in_review' (banner-tone info; flipped from 'pending' during earlier finalize test — banner contract intact), all 3 action buttons rendered as DIVs with data-disabled='true' and aria-disabled='true' with subtitle 'Disponible al aprobar KYB'. /client/profile shows org card (legal_name, org_id=org_seed_alemany, country AR, tier T2, env sandbox, KYB badge=APPROVED) and user card (email, role=client_admin, user_id=usr_seed_alemany_admin). /apply (no token) shows legacy form with data-testid='apply-form'. /apply?token=<valid> shows full 7-step wizard with data-testid='apply-wizard', 'apply-stepper', step-1..step-7, apply-back (disabled on step 1) and apply-next; pre-filled context populates the wizard; step 1→2 navigation works.

design_issues.screen: /apply wizard (step 2 — Tu identidad) and legacy /apply form
issues: FECHA NAC. and INCORPORATION DATE use native browser date picker (mm/dd/yyyy). Same finding as iteration_10 — replace with shadcn DatePicker for consistency.

action_items: (Optional polish) Replace native HTML date inputs in /apply (legacy + wizard step 2) with the shadcn DatePicker component used elsewhere in the design system.

(Informational) finpact org.kyb_status is now 'in_review' (flipped from 'pending' after the /apply/finalize test). If next iteration needs a 'pending' state for visual QA, re-seed via `python -m backend.seed.seed_phase1` or manually reset that org's kyb_status.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend correctly maps Mongo position fields (principal_usd → principal, accrued_interest → accrued, start → start_date, maturity → maturity_date) — review_request expectation satisfied.
/apply/finalize is single-use: SIGNED_LINKS row is marked status='used' atomically via filtered update; second call returns 401 'Link already used or expired'. Replay protection verified.
Conditional kyb_status flip only triggers when current status is in {None, pending, needs_info} — won't reset 'approved' or 'rejected' clients, good defensive logic.
Email integration uses preview_only (RESEND_API_KEY empty in .env) — confirmed MOCKED. compliance@prosper.foundation email is queued correctly with template='kyb_submitted'.

Frontend ActionBtn cleanly distinguishes enabled (renders <Link>) vs disabled (renders <div data-disabled='true' aria-disabled='true'>) with 'Disponible al aprobar KYB' subtitle when locked. Good a11y.
client_portal.py is 309 lines, well under the 700-line threshold; logically split: protected /client/* router + public /apply/* router in the same module which is acceptable for the size.
test_credentials: admin@prosper.foundation, client.admin@alemany.capital (approved), client.admin@finpact.io (was pending, now in_review after finalize). All via /api/v1/auth/dev-login.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 7 backend + frontend are stable. Suite at /app/backend/tests/test_phase7_client_portal.py runs in ~5s. Note: each `test_finalize_*` call consumes a fresh KYB link, so re-running the suite generates new alerts and emails (cumulative side-effects on org_seed_finpact). If a new test needs the 'pending' banner state, target a different org (e.g. create a fresh org via super_admin POST /admin/clients) instead of finpact. ClientGateBanner data-status values seen: 'pending'|'in_review'|'needs_info'|'rejected'.
